    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AcademicContext
    Represents temporal academic facts and context extracted from course-linked journal notes.
    AcademicEvent
    Represents a rigid academic event or deadline occurring at a specific date and time.
    AcademicEventRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for AcademicEvent entities.
    AcademicEventRequest
    Request payload for creating or fully updating an AcademicEvent.
    AcademicEventResponse
    Response representation for an AcademicEvent.
    AcademicEventService
    Service contract for academic event management.
    BadRequestException
    Canonical domain exception thrown when an incoming request or operation violates domain business rules, domain invariants, or cross-entity integrity constraints.
    Course
    Represents an academic course or subject offering.
    CourseRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Course aggregate root entities.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Centralized RFC 7807 Problem Details error handler for all REST controllers.
    ImageMetadata
    Value object representing metadata and AI-extracted context for an embedded note image.
    ImageMetadataUpdateRequest
    Targeted update payload used by AI pipelines to update note image metadata without mutating student-authored markdown text.
    ImageReferencesValidator
    Validates that image reference labels present in markdown correspond bijectively to keys in the note's imageMetadata map.
    Note
    Represents a course-linked journal entry containing student notes in JSON format.
    NoteContent
    Structured content of a note containing a markdown body and accompanying image metadata.
    NoteContentConverter
    JPA AttributeConverter that persists structured NoteContent as JSON TEXT in SQLite.
    NoteRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Note entities.
    NoteRequest
    Request payload for creating or fully updating a Note.
    NoteResponse
    Response representation for course-linked journal entries.
    NoteService
    Service contract for course-linked journal note management and AI image metadata annotation.
    NyareApplication
     
    ResourceNotFoundException
    Thrown when an entity or resource referenced by an identifier cannot be found in persistence.
    Schedule
    Represents a recurring weekly class meeting time for a course.
    ScheduleRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Schedule entities.
    ScheduleRequest
    Request payload for creating or fully updating a class Schedule.
    ScheduleResponse
    Response representation for a class Schedule.
    ScheduleService
    Service contract for class schedule management.
    Task
    Represents an actionable task or study recommendation for a student.
    TaskRepository
    Spring Data JPA repository for Task entities.
    TaskRequest
    Request payload for creating or fully updating a Task.
    TaskResponse
    Response representation for academic tasks.
    TaskService
    Service contract for academic task management, lifecycle transitions, and study plan operations.
    TaskStatus
    Represents the lifecycle status of an academic task in the study plan.
    TaskStatusRequest
    Request payload for updating the status of a Task.
    ValidImageReferences
    Validates that all reference-style image links in markdown correspond bijectively to keys in the image metadata map.
    WebConfig
    Web MVC configuration enabling Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) for development.
